title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: The vertical-MCP wave rotates to creative & media — video generation, listing video, DAM, and 4K signage text are now agent-callable
bullets.summary: VEED generates avatar videos from inside Claude/ChatGPT/Make, AVCLabs exposes AI video enhancement + image segmentation as agent tools, reel-estate-mcp turns listing photos into finished voiced listing videos from plain-language prompts, and Higgsfield's GPT Image 2 does near-perfect 4K text rendering flagged for posters, product labels, and signage.
bullets.how: Leads today and it is the most on-brand surface yet: signage mockups and real-estate listing video are exactly Brand 9 Signs' output, now producible by an agent. Stand up one Construct creative-production operator that reads these media MCPs; don't resell any single tool.

bullets.title: Perplexity pushes its 'Computer' agent to Windows and into the enterprise — a $200/mo desktop fleet routing across ~20 models, aimed at Microsoft and Salesforce
bullets.summary: The July 28 Windows launch extends Perplexity's agentic desktop platform from Mac to ~1.4B devices, reads local files, coordinates 19-20 frontier models, and carries a 'Brain' cross-session memory graph.
bullets.how: A general-purpose desktop agent fleet is now a $200/mo commodity; The Construct's edge is vertical operator depth (signage, owned-presence, alt-data) and orchestration discipline, not 'we have agents.' Watch it as the competitive floor, not a build target.

bullets.title: Anthropic distribution consolidation holds — Opus 5 the default tier, the 2026-07-28 MCP spec (stateless core + Apps + Tasks + hardened OAuth/OIDC) landing inside Claude, MCP past 400M monthly SDK downloads
bullets.summary: The platform story remains standardization and reach, not a new model tier; the finalized 2026-07-28 spec is the stable substrate to build the fleet on, with MCP SDK downloads up 4x YoY.
bullets.how: Keep migrating The Construct's internal servers to 2026-07-28 and run the least-authority token-scope pass; the standardized substrate is where our own MCPs get leverage.

bullets.title: Frontier field stays seated — no new model cleared the 24h bar; Opus 5 (Jul 24) still newest tier, Gemini 3.6 Flash and price-cut GPT-5.6 Luna/Terra the cheap workhorses
bullets.summary: Competition is on unit cost and fit, not capability; Mistral's open-weight MoE remains in early access rather than a formal release.
bullets.how: Hold the reasoning tier (Opus 5) and route cheap bulk to Flash/Luna; 'best fit wins,' no model switch this cycle.

bullets.title: arXiv: 'Reinforcement Learning for LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems through Orchestration Traces' (2605.02801)
bullets.summary: Learns orchestration from interaction graphs, decomposing the controller into five explicit sub-decisions: when to spawn, whom to delegate to, how to communicate, how to aggregate, and when to stop.
bullets.how: The next layer above yesterday's 'harden the single agent first' rubric: once each operator is hardened in isolation, the orchestration decisions become their own designed, measurable layer of The Construct.

praxis_lesson: In one more week the vertical-MCP wave rotated again — from ad-intelligence to sales-intelligence/revenue-ops to now creative & media (video, listing video, DAM, 4K signage text), the most on-brand Brand 9 Signs surface it has hit. The operator wedge is unchanged: don't resell any single media tool; stand up one Construct creative-production operator that reads the freshest media MCPs, run each through the least-authority scope pass, harden it in isolation — and now, per 2605.02801, treat orchestration itself (when to spawn, delegate, aggregate, stop) as an explicit designed layer above the hardened operators. Own the production pipeline and the orchestration discipline, not any one generator.
